concerns.text: FR-009 mandates a 'Sim-to-Real Adapter or Fine-tuning Protocol' using 18 real-world videos. T020 only loads weights and T006 logs metrics. No task implements the actual training/fine-tuning logic, violating the requirement to adapt the controller for domain shift.

FR-006 and US-2 require logging failure modes ('Planner Infeasibility' vs 'Controller Execution Failure') to `data/interim/execution_logs.parquet`. T023 implements detection logic, but no task explicitly persists this label to the parquet file referenced in T025, leaving the acceptance criterion unverified.

FR-008 requires an ablation study varying state representation detail. T039/T040 implement the graph modes, but no task orchestrates the comparative execution or generates the `data/interim/ablation_results.parquet` artifact required by the plan, failing to satisfy the FR.

Plan.md Phase 0 requires 'Baseline Re-Execution' to generate `data/interim/baseline_results.parquet` for statistical comparison (US-3). No corresponding task exists in tasks.md to load the 18 tasks and execute the original RoboDojo Neural Policy, dropping a critical acceptance criterion.

US-4 and SC-006 require calculating the 'Physics Fidelity Gap' by comparing Oracle and Real-World success rates. T035 implements the Oracle, but no task explicitly runs the control experiment sequence (feeding plans to Oracle) and generates the `data/interim/oracle_results.json` artifact needed for T037.

SC-005 requires measuring catastrophic failure rate against a ≤ 5% threshold. T032 calculates the rate but lacks a task to define the threshold constant, perform the comparison check, and flag the pass/fail condition in the report, leaving the acceptance criterion incomplete.

US-1 Acceptance Scenario 3 requires the process to 'MUST NOT crash due to OOM errors' if RAM > 6 GB. T017 monitors memory but lacks a task to enforce the hard constraint (e.g., raising an error or halting execution) if the limit is exceeded, weakening the safety guarantee.
